Support the broader accounting team with audit requests, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as they arise. Coordinate with project managers, treasury, and senior management to align cash forecasts with milestones and capital call schedules so funding precedes major expenditures. Support budget preparation and monthly variance analysis, developing bottom-up capital budgets with project managers and preparing explanations that distinguish timing differences from scope changes and true overruns. Complete monthly and quarterly reporting required by individual project agreements, including investor reports, lender compliance packages, and project-level financial statements. Assist with quarterly and annual financial statement preparation and the annual audit, including audit schedules, auditor inquiries, and audit-ready project files maintained year-round. Support the annual capital budget process, coordinating with project managers to compile and review capital project budgets. Maintain and enforce project cost coding standards in D365 to prevent misclassification of operating costs as capital expenditures (or vice versa), and maintain a self-serve coding reference guide for project managers and AP staff. Conduct periodic audits of project cost transactions to identify miscoded items, duplicate charges, or unapproved commitments, and work with the relevant teams to resolve and prevent recurrence. Establish month-end review checklists and project close-out procedures that confirm all costs are captured, coded, and reconciled before reports are issued. Escalate control issues such as budget overruns, unauthorized commitments, or unusual cost patterns, and prepare a monthly project controls summary of open issues, corrective actions, and emerging risks. Support the tax teams and external tax advisors with project cost schedules, asset classification detail, and cost basis documentation segregated by asset type, jurisdiction, and tax treatment. Are proficient in Microsoft Dynamics 365, with the ability to navigate the Project Management module and extract, analyze, and report on project cost data with minimal support. Are familiar with procurement and payment management software, preferably D365 Procurement & Sourcing and IBM Maximo (others considered), including a solid understanding of requisition and purchase order approval workflows and how POs and invoices flow into the project ledger. Are comfortable using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Power BI to build spending reports, automate variance analysis, and present financial data to technical and non-technical audiences. Have strong Microsoft Excel skills, including modeling, pivot tables, and large data set management; Power Query and Fabric experience is a plus. Can manage multiple active projects simultaneously, meeting recurring deadlines while maintaining the attention to detail accurate reporting requires. Bring exceptional analytical and reasoning ability, with strong quantitative skills and the instinct to dig into variances and understand the “why” behind the numbers. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to present project financial status in management meetings, investor calls, and audit settings. Take a collaborative approach that builds strong relationships with project managers, AP, treasury, tax, and senior leadership, translating complex financial data into clear, actionable insight. Have a strong sense of ownership, surfacing issues before they escalate and operating with the integrity and professionalism LS Power's investors and partners expect. Ideally, You Have Bachelor's degree in Accounting; a master's degree or CPA designation is a plus. Minimum of four years of accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to capital project or construction accounting in an energy, power generation, or capital-intensive industry. Experience managing project accounting in a multi-entity environment with active capital development programs. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Project Management module) or a comparable ERP/project accounting system; configuring or maintaining project cost structures is a plus. Demonstrated experience with budget preparation, variance analysis, and cash flow forecasting for capital projects, and preparing financial reports for lenders and senior management

Redactar informes de estado, presentaciones, monitoreo y seguimiento, identificando deficiencias en la entrega, llevarlas a la atención del supervisor y sugerir acciones correctivas. Realizar otras tareas relacionadas según se asignen. Qualifications Experiencia y Cualidades Requeridas Educación Profesional en arquitectur, Ingenieria Civil, Construccion o carreras en áreas afines con mínimo dos (2) años de experiencia relevante; o Bachiller con mínimo cuatro (4) años de experiencia pertinente Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experiencia Experiencia en intervenciones en agua, saneamiento e higiene y diseño, adecuación y mejora de infraestructuras en alojamientos temporales, espacios comunitarios y públicos. Conocimiento en trabajo participativo y enfoques comunitarios de participación Conocimientos en accesibilidad universal y diseño inclusivo de espacios públicos Conocimientos de enfoques medio ambientales y alternativas sostenibles en obras e intervenciones WASH Lenguaje Todos los miembros del personal de la OIM, en todas las categorías, deben tener dominio de al menos uno de los idiomas oficiales de la OIM (inglés, francés o español). Para Esta Posición Requerido: Todos los candidatos deberán desenvolverse con fluidez en español (oral y escrito). Deseable Contar con un nivel de inglés Avanzado (oral y escrito) El dominio del/de los idioma(s) requerido(s) será evaluado específicamente durante el proceso de selección, el cual podrá incluir evaluaciones escritas y/o orales. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. La OIM no cobra ninguna tarifa en ninguna etapa de su proceso de contratación (solicitud, entrevista, tramitación, formación u otros cargos). La OIM no solicita información sobre cuentas bancaria. La OIM solo acepta solicitudes debidamente completadas y enviadas a través del IOM e-Recruitment (for internal candidates link here). Esta herramienta en línea también permite a los candidatos realizar un seguimiento del estado de su solicitud. No se aceptarán solicitudes tardías. Solo se contactará a los candidatos preseleccionados.
